csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using UnityEngine.SceneManagement; public class FixAllCameras { public static void Execute() { Material skyMat = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>("Assets/Materials/ProceduralSky.mat"); if (skyMat == null) { Debug.Log("Sky mat not found."); return; } for (int i = 0; i < SceneManager.sceneCount; i++) { Scene s = SceneManager.GetSceneAt(i); if (!s.isLoaded) continue; var roots = s.GetRootGameObjects(); foreach (var go in roots) { var lights = go.GetComponentsInChildren<Light>(true); foreach (var l in lights) { if (l.type == LightType.Directional) { l.shadows = LightShadows.Soft; l.intensity = 1.2f; l.color = new Color(1f, 0.95f, 0.9f); } } var cams = go.GetComponentsInChildren<Camera>(true); foreach (var cam in cams) { cam.clearFlags = CameraClearFlags.Skybox; var ucam = cam.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal.UniversalAdditionalCameraData>(); if (ucam != null) { ucam.renderType = UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal.CameraRenderType.Base; } EditorUtility.SetDirty(cam); Debug.Log("Set Skybox on camera: " + cam.name + " in scene " + s.name); } } } Scene activeBefore = SceneManager.GetActiveScene(); for (int i = 0; i < SceneManager.sceneCount; i++) { SceneManager.SetActiveScene(SceneManager.GetSceneAt(i)); RenderSettings.skybox = skyMat; DynamicGI.UpdateEnvironment(); } SceneManager.SetActiveScene(activeBefore); UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveOpenScenes(); Debug.Log("Forced Skybox on all cameras and scenes."); } }
